artworks.title: Title Page to Sir Dudly Digges, The Compleat Ambassador
artworks.description: Three figures are depicted in a full-length view in a regal or formal setting. The central figure is seated on an ornate throne, wearing a crown and holding a scepter. Her robe is elaborate and she appears to have curly hair styled in an elegant updo. The figure on the left is standing and wearing a decorated robe and hat, holding a square flat object with a design on it. The figure on the right is also standing and dressed in a richly detailed garment, holding a scroll in his hand. The background features draped curtains, a textured backdrop, and a decorative emblem above the seated figure. An inscription below describes the subject as the "Compleat Ambassador."

artworks.title: Title Page to Jeremy Taylor, The Great Exemplar
artworks.description: The engraving shows a depiction of a woman, a child, multiple adult figures, and several symbolic elements. At the center, a woman and a child are shown from waist up. The woman is holding the child. The child has curly hair. Both figures are surrounded by a halo and embraced by an angel from above. Above them, a cherubic face watches from below. Surrounding this central image are multiple square panels featuring different scenes: the top left and right panels depict elderly figures with long hair and beards, engrossed in writing or reading. Directly below the top left figure is a round inset showing a divine or spiritual figure in light amid clouds, while the middle bottom left and right panels exhibit similar elder figures. On the right, there is a scene with a cross labeled 'INRI,' surrounded by symbolic elements such as a skull and lightning. All these components are framed with decorative details and placed on a backdrop of engraved text, patterns, and engravings depicting religious and symbolic iconography, including a crown and angelic faces.

artworks.title: Title Page to the Work of Homer, Translated by Thomas Hobbes
artworks.description: The illustration features a bust of Homer at the top, flanked by two soldiers in armor holding spears. Below is an inscription for "The Workes of Homer" by T. Hobbes. In the center bottom is a portrait of Thomas Hobbes. The background is ornately engraved with the publisher's information stating "London Printed for W: Crooke at the green Dragon, without Temple Barre. 1677."

artworks.title: Dr. William Davison, Scotch Chemist and Physician in Paris
artworks.description: The image shows a man positioned facing forward but with his head slightly turned to the left. He has a mustache and long, curly hair. He has a calm expression and is wearing period clothing. The background features an intricately designed oval frame with text and below it, a coat of arms with a helmet, shield, and decorative elements. The background is detailed and textured.

artworks.title: John Dethick
artworks.description: This image is a portrait of a man from the chest up. He is seated or in a slightly oblique position. The man has distinctive features such as a neat beard and mustache. His hair, under a cap, is short and slightly curled. He is wearing formal historical attire with ornate buttons and a large collar around his neck. There are no visible jewelry pieces. The background has a line-etched pattern, framed by an oval border with embellishments and inscriptions at the bottom, including a coat of arms.

artworks.title: John Donne, Poet
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man's upper body in an oval frame. The man is facing forward with curly, shoulder-length hair and a full beard. He has deep-set eyes and wears draped fabric resembling classical garments. The background features a patterned design. Below the oval frame, there is an adorned banner with text.

artworks.title: Sir Samuel Morland, Diplomatist and Inventor
artworks.artist: Pierre Lombard after Sir Peter Lely
artworks.description: The image is a portrait of a man. He is shown in a three-quarter view, facing slightly to the left. The man has long, wavy hair and facial features including a prominent nose, rounded chin, full lips, and a contemplative gaze. He is dressed in a dark coat with visible buttons and a white collar. The portrait is framed by an ornate, oval border, and the background has a textured pattern. Below the portrait, there is a crest with text.

artworks.title: Alexander, Chaplain to Charles I, Author
artworks.description: The image features a man seated at a desk. He has a beard, mustache and medium length wavy hair. He is wearing a robe with billowing sleeves and a collar. He is holding a pen and there is an open book on the desk. The background shows detailed bookshelves filled with books and two globes on either side of him.

artworks.title: Alexander Ross, Chaplain to Charles I
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man identified as Alexander Ross, depicted from the waist up seated behind a desk. His arms are resting on an open book, and he holds a quill in his right hand. He has a full beard and mustache, wavy shoulder-length hair, and prominent facial features. Ross is dressed in an academic or ecclesiastical robe with a ruffled white collar. The background features a detailed library setting with shelves of books, drawn curtains, and two globes in front of his desk.

artworks.title: Sir Robert Stapylton, Dramatic Poet and Translator
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man's upper body. He is facing forward with long wavy hair, a straight nose, and a subtle expression. The man is dressed in historical formal attire, including a dark vest over a white shirt with a decorative lace collar. The background features an oval frame around the portrait. Below the portrait, there is a decorative emblem with inscriptions and circular designs.

artworks.title: Jeremy Taylor, Bishop of Down, Connor and Dromore
artworks.description: The image shows an upper-body portrait of a man facing forward with his head turned slightly to his left. The man has a serious expression and sharp facial features, including a strong brow line, a prominent nose, and defined cheekbones. His hair is neatly styled with loose waves and he appears to be wearing a cap. The man wears formal attire typical of the time, including a dark robe with a broad white collar, and is holding a small book. The portrait is surrounded by an oval frame with intricate detailing against a shaded background. Below the image is an inscription in Latin and an emblem with a coat of arms featuring a lion and stylized designs. The composition is meticulously engraved, providing a textured appearance.

artworks.title: Jeremy Taylor, Bishop of Down, Connor and Dromore
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man from the waist up, in a formal pose. His hair is styled with a middle part and falls neatly to the sides. He has a stern facial expression with pronounced cheekbones, a broad forehead, and a slightly furrowed brow. He wears a formal robe with a wide, turned-down collar and multiple layers of clothing visible beneath. He holds a book in his hands, with his fingers poised over the pages. The portrait is set within an oval frame with an inscription and a heraldic crest below it. The background has a textured pattern.

artworks.title: Sir Henry Wotton, Diplomatist and Poet
artworks.description: The image is a portrait of a person from the waist up. The individual is seated, leaning on their right arm with their head in their hand. They have a full beard and mustache, and neatly combed hair. They are wearing an elaborate garment with a fur collar, embroidery on the sleeves, and a high, ruffled collar. There is no visible jewelry or objects in their hands. The background has a textured or patterned surface with drapery on the top left. The words "PHILOSOPHEMVR" are on the left side and a circular emblem with a heart shape is on the lower part of the image.

artworks.title: Sir Henry Wotton, Diplomatist and Poet
artworks.description: The image shows a man resting his head on his hand with the rest of his body also visible. He is depicted with a slightly turned position, resting his right elbow on a surface with his left hand partially visible as it lies across his torso. The man has a mustache and a pointed beard, with receding hair styled neatly. He is wearing a detailed garment with a high, lace-trimmed collar and a fur-lined cloak or robe. The sleeves of his clothing have intricate designs with patterns and bands. The background shows draped fabric and the word "PHILOSOPHVN" inscribed. In the foreground, an emblem of a heart with a lock appears, alongside a key, with the name "Sr. Henry Wotton Kt." inscribed.

artworks.title: Oliver Cromwell
artworks.description: The engraving depicts a man in armor looking directly at the viewer. The man has detailed facial features, wavy hair, and is holding a sword. Another man with long hair is aiding him. In the background, there is a maritime battle scene. Text above indicates it is a formal portrait, and below is a coat of arms with ornate text.

artworks.title: Sir Tobias Matthew, Diplomatist and Writer
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man's upper half, including his head and upper torso. The man is facing forward with his head slightly turned to the right. He has a distinct facial expression with arched eyebrows, a neatly groomed mustache and beard, and short, combed-back hair. He is wearing a dark doublet with intricate detailing on the front, a large, wide pleated ruff collar, and a decorative chain around his chest. His right hand is resting on the doublet. The background features a patterned circular frame, creating an oval vignette effect around the man's figure. Below the portrait, there is an inscription with the name of the individual: "The lively Portraicture of Sr Tobias Mathewes Knt. James Gammon sculp."

artworks.title: Anne, Duchess of Albemarle
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a woman from the chest up. She is positioned facing slightly to the side but looking directly at the viewer. Her facial features are detailed with expressive eyes, a prominent nose, and a subtle smile. Her hair is styled in loose curls that fall over her shoulders, partly covering her ears. She is wearing a dress with voluminous sleeves, adorned with intricate designs, and has a pearl necklace around her neck. The portrait is enclosed within an ornate circular frame that resembles a wreath tied with ribbons. The background features finely engraved lines that highlight the depth of the image. An inscription at the bottom reads, "Anne Duchesses of Allemarle."

artworks.title: Title Page to J. Moxon, Ductor ad Astronomianet Geographiam
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an illustrated book title page for 'Ductor ad Astronomiam & Geographiam'. The illustration features two seated figures at the top, each holding a globe, with a collection of books and a scroll between them. Below them, is a large scroll bearing the title and a list of subjects related to astronomy and geography. Flanking this scroll are two standing, elaborately dressed figures each holding scientific instruments; one with a quadrant and the other with a rolled map. At the bottom is a detailed depiction of a city skyline, identified as London. The artwork is intricately detailed, showcasing elements of classical attire, scientific exploration, and geographical representation characteristic of the period. The engraving adds depth and texture, enhancing the vintage and academic appeal of the composition.

artworks.title: George Monk, First Duke of Albemarle
artworks.description: The image is an engraving showing an upper body depiction of a man in a formal and upright position. He has prominent facial features, including a mustache and long, curly hair flowing down to his shoulders. He wears a laurel wreath on his head. His clothing includes a high lace collar, an ornate cloak with detailed embroidery, and a sash adorned with patterns and medallions. He holds a helmet in his left hand. The background has a cross-hatched pattern, and there is cursive text below the illustration.

artworks.title: Lady Ferrers
artworks.description: The image shows a woman in a three-quarter view portrait, displaying her upper body from the shoulders up. She is facing slightly to the left with her head turned towards the viewer. The woman has distinct features including a long nose and a slightly pursed mouth. Her hair is styled in tight curls framing her face and is partly tied back. She is adorned with a pearl necklace and drop earrings. She wears a dark, off-the-shoulder garment with a broad neckline. The background features an oval frame with lined patterns around the portrait.

artworks.title: Elizabeth Talbot, Countess of Kent, Authoress
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a woman from the waist up, positioned facing slightly to the right with her head turned towards the viewer. Her facial features are detailed, with a serious expression. She has curly hair that falls to her shoulders, covered partially by a cap. She wears a dark garment with a broad collar and a bow at the neckline. Around her neck, she wears a string of beads or pearls. The portrait is framed by an oval border with an interwoven pattern, and the name "Elizabeth" and the title "Late Countess of Kent" inscribed at the bottom. The background is engraved with diagonal lines.

artworks.title: John Selden, Jurist and Antiquary
artworks.description: The image displays an upper-body portrait of a man seated and facing slightly to his right. He has distinct facial features with a defined face and deep-set eyes. His hair is curly, falling to his shoulders. He is dressed in a dark garment with a wide collar. The background features an ornamental frame with interlocking laurel leaves, centered around the man's head and shoulders. The image has a textured, engraved appearance. The lower portion contains a script identifying the subject as "Learned Antiquary John Selden," with the artist's signature underneath.

artworks.title: John Selden, Jurist and Antiquary
artworks.description: The image displays a portrait of a man from the waist up. He faces slightly left with his gaze forward. The man has long, wavy hair, a long nose, high cheekbones, and a slightly furrowed brow. He wears a dark, ornate garment with a white collar. The background features an oval laurel wreath design surrounding the portrait. Below, there is decorative script identifying him as John Selden, alongside what looks like a signature or inscription by the artist.

artworks.title: John Selden, Jurist and Antiquary
artworks.description: The image depicts the upper body of a man identified as John Selden. He is facing forward with a slight turn to his left, showing more of his right side. He has a straight nose, full lips, and a strong jawline. His hair is styled in loose curls with bangs. He is dressed in a dark garment with a high collar, a buttoned vest, and a cloak-like garment draped over his shoulders. The portrait is in an oval frame with a decorative pattern, set against a background of parallel lines. Text below the image identifies him as 'The true and Lively Portraiture of that Learned Antiquary John Selden.'
